prompt: Challenge C144-CH2: Downstream purification — specifically the ultrafiltration step — runs at only 55% of nominal throughput because the membranes foul with res

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Cross-flow ultrafiltration with spiral-wound polyethersulfone membranes experiences irreversible fouling that reduces flux within hours of operation, and this fouling can be partially reversed through multi-step alkaline and acid cleaning protocols.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07419","field":"abstract","quote":"Irreversible fouling after 8 h was quantified at 18 % flux loss; a two-step cleaning sequence (0.3 % citric acid, then 0.5 % NaOH) restored 94 %"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07415","field":"abstract","quote":"Permeate flux declined by 65–80 % within the first 30 min of operation regardless of operating condition"}]},{"text":"Phospholipid aggregates and other polar compounds cause rapid pore constriction and concentration polarisation in membrane filtration, and resistance-in-series analysis can quantify the contribution of reversible versus irreversible fouling mechanisms.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07415","field":"abstract","quote":"Permeate flux declined by 65–80 % within the first 30 min of operation regardless of operating condition, indicating rapid pore constriction by phospholipid aggregates"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-07415","field":"abstract","quote":"Resistance-in-series analysis attributed 55 % of total resistance to reversible concentration polarisation and 45 % to irreversible fouling"}]},{"text":"Pretreatment effectiveness and upstream filtration design critically influence membrane fouling rates, and pilot-scale testing with controlled operating parameters can identify stable operating windows that minimise flux decline.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-07417","field":"abstract","quote":"Cross-flow microfiltration of crude and partially refined oils is discussed with reference to fouling mechanisms, critical flux, and membrane selection"},{"id":"R0654","field":"bio","quote":"His research group focuses on solid–liquid separation in edible-oil processing, covering dead-end and cross-flow filtration, filter-aid characterisation"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher's work addresses membrane fouling, cross-flow ultrafiltration cleaning protocols, and solid-liquid separation fundamentals [SYN-PUB-07419, SYN-PUB-07415, SYN-PUB-07417], but focuses on oil processing rather than protein/biomass recovery, and does not directly address pre-filtration design or residual whole-cell contamination in biopharmaceutical contexts."}
